Retention
VictoriaMetrics, VictoriaLogs, VictoriaTraces and Pyroscope keep 7 days. ClickHouse keeps the same traces and logs for 90 days (7 days on the hot volume, then the RustFS cold volume), which is where a question older than a week goes. Edge access logs reach ClickHouse only: the VictoriaLogs pipeline drops them. Every arrow into Grafana is a query, one datasource per backend.
